# How To: 'Katniss Everdeen' Archer Build

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_33_nukaknights-post-build-archer.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The bow has only been a part of the game in Fallout 76 since the Wastelanders update and is unfortunately a rarely used weapon. I changed my sniper character to archer again and this time I was pleasantly surprised. The gameplay is once again completely different than the usual commando rifle build and can definitely hold its own.

Since the bow contains the keyword "HasSilencer" just like silenced weapons, it can be played very well with "Sandman". This gives you a huge advantage at night.

This build plays bloodstained (low HP, high radiation) without power armor and with bow/crossbow and with Unyielding/Strengthening armor.

## IMPORTANT: HOW TO PLAY WITH BOWS

**Dealing with VATS Bug:** Since there are currently still problems with accuracy with loading weapons in VATS (bows, Gauss pistol, Gauss rifle, etc.), you will have to adapt your playing style with bows accordingly. What works well is:

1. 
 Draw the bow
2. 
 Enable VATS
3. 
 Release shot

After the VATS is active, you can continue shooting and hitting. If you activate the VATS first and then draw the bow, this often leads to missed hits. But I was able to adjust to it quickly.

**Range:** Bows have a theoretical range of 300 but this is hardly usable in practice as the arrows fall very quickly and land on the bow. This makes it very difficult to hit with a bow at a distance. **It's not a problem in VATS**, where the trajectory is automatically calculated and you hit very well.

## EQUIPMENT

***Armor**:* There are several options when it comes to armor for a Bloodstained Archer. Some rely on Fortifying Armor (the lower your health, the higher your damage resistance), some rely on Unyielding (your SPECIAL stats increase the lower your health), and there are also people who only rely on Stealth (Chameleon/Weightless/etc). I tried to play completely on strength, but then I always have problems with the weight. I'm currently playing an Unyielding Secret Service set with AP regeneration, "harder to detect when sneaking" and a few other effects that unfortunately aren't always perfect with Secret Service armor.

It's best to always try to find armor with AP regeneration and "Hard to detect while sneaking". You need AP (action points) as an archer, especially for the VATS. If you have a part with "Hard to detect while sneaking", that's enough. For AP regeneration it should be 2-3 parts for a good effect. However, unyielding armor also makes more sense for an archer in the legendary race, as you get significantly more XP and thus score SCORE points more quickly. You should install the “Asbestos-lined” mod on the torso in order not to be damaged by the falling glowing boulders in the Monongah Mine.

Additionally, problem-solving armor is available for silo runs.

**Weapons**: Bloodstained Compound Bow (+50% body part damage), Bloodstained Bow with Explo Mod, Bloodstained Crossbow (+50% body part damage) and for some events I also carry an automatic Vampire Explo battle rifle, which in these cases I use for shooting without any skill.

**Backpack:** Pharmacist Backpack (Raider) with 90% weight reduction on Chems and Stimpaks (Saves the Travel First Aid Kit perk)

## SKILL SET

**Strength 3**: Weapon Belt at 2, Strongly Built 1

**Perception** **15**: All 3 point Archer cards (+Professional + Master). Additionally Concentrated Fire at 3, for targeted headshots. And "Getting the hang of it" for better armor penetration.

**Endurance 5**: Here I use Radicool to get more load capacity
